reclassification.evidence: 28bf3c25 scripts/orchestrator/dispatch.mjs:79,93-94 reuse dispatch/KEY-aN for an unregistered (refused) attempt; :105-107 copy files with mkdir recursive and no cleanup, so prd.md/tech-spec.md from a refused full attempt survive in snapshot/ beside the new extracts (refusals after copy: render :131, gate :132-133, spawn :134). But no code reads snapshot/: the worker prompt dispatch.md is re-rendered from current extracts (:123,:131), the template has no snapshot path, worker grants exclude dispatch/ (references/orchestration.md:654). The only reader of such a directory would be accept.mjs amend --full-snapshot --snapshot DIR (accept.mjs:144-147), and only if an operator passed dispatch/KEY-aN/snapshot, which no pinned doc or skill instructs (skills/mono-orchestrate/SKILL.md:212 says only '--full-snapshot when requested'). The 'contaminates the worker snapshot' consequence and the gate-bypass label are not supported by the pinned code; the harm is a misleading dispatch artifact. Disagree on danger.

cases.trigger: A new missing write precedes an already-applied id reused with changed payload.
cases.consequence: The confirmation stub stops at first missing write; accept prints the conflicting later write before checking every identity.

cases.trigger: A process command argument contains the expected MONO_ATTEMPT marker, but its environment does not.
cases.consequence: Combined ps argv/environment parsing falsely attributes the unrelated process.
cases.oracle: host independent gold; orchestrator round 1 decision

reclassification.evidence: 02efa6e6 scripts/runtime.mjs:138-157 readProcessAttemptMarker on darwin (:147-152) splits 'ps eww' output (argv followed by environment) on whitespace and matches a MONO_ATTEMPT=<marker> argv token; Linux (:144-146) reads /proc/<pid>/environ correctly. A false 'matched' makes backup-switch.mjs:90-91 push a remnant and :94 refuse. Same consequence path as #69 (false refusal of an ordinary switch; pinned orchestration.md:785-789: unrelated utilities do not block). Dataset danger=false contradicts its own #69 label; dangerous (gate-stall). Low confidence: the argv token is the attempt's random UUID (launch.mjs:305).
